messages:
maria.design: Ok team — quick sync on the sidebar regrouping prototype I posted. Goal: reduce cognitive load for new users and make deep links predictable. Link: https://figma.redwood/console/rail-proto
devin.pm: skimmed it — overall 👍. Main concern: will moving 'Models' under 'Serving' break existing bookmarked links? we have customers with saved URLs.
oliver.frontend: good call. We should keep stable URL surface for existing routes and add redirect mapping for old -> new. can do a middleware 301 with a small compatibility layer.
kai.eng: +1 on middleware. also want to log redirect hits for 30d so we can inform customers before removing legacy routes.
sophie.a11y: noticed keyboard focus jumps when collapsing groups. If we auto-collapse the rail on small widths, focus lands awkwardly. we should set focus to the first visible item and announce the collapse via aria-live.
maria.design: agreed on accessibility. Proposal: when a group collapses, announce "Group X collapsed, Y items hidden" and move focus to the group header. keeps screenreader users oriented.
oliver.frontend: implementation note — we can use `role=button` on headers and manage `aria-expanded`. also add `data-old-path` attrs to items so the redirect map can look up legacy slugs.
devin.pm: breadcrumbs — do we want them to reflect folder-like IA (Workspace > App > Route) or be action-oriented (Back to Workloads, View Model)? mix of both might confuse.
maria.design: leaning folder-like for consistency with deep links: /console/:org/:space/:resource/:id. but for quick actions we can add contextual action buttons beside breadcrumbs.
kai.eng: for deep links we need canonical param rules. propose: stable path segments only, optional query params for UI state, e.g. `?panel=metrics&focus=logs`. Example:```/console/acme/prod/serving/rt-1234?panel=metrics&focus=logs```
sophie.a11y: small nit — avoid encoding critical app state in fragment identifiers (hash) because some assistive tech treats them differently. prefer query params or path segments.
maria.design: good catch. We'll standardize on path + query param pattern.
devin.pm: how about versioning? If we change grouping names later, we should still support old segment names for a transition period. maybe route aliases: `/models` -> `/serving/models`.
oliver.frontend: route aliases + canonicalize middleware + redirect logger. and in the console UI, show a small banner when you've been redirected: "You're viewing Model X (migrated path)." with a link to update bookmark.
kai.eng: can we include an experiment flag to enable new IA for 20% of users so we can measure discoverability and drop-off?
maria.design: yes — rollout plan: canary (internal) -> 20% experiment -> 100% with 30d redirect monitoring -> deprecation notice.
sophie.a11y: accessibility test plan: keyboard nav pass, screenreader walkthrough, high-contrast check, focus order audit. I'll put a checklist in the ticket.
devin.pm: copy tweak: change breadcrumb separator from '>' to '›' for less visual noise. thoughts?
maria.design: fine by me, small UI polish. include alt text for separators for a11y.
oliver.frontend: final dev tasks: add alias mapping table, implement 301 middleware, aria-live announcement, add banner copy, log redirect metric. estimate 3 dev days + 1 design QA.
kai.eng: I'll allocate review time and set up the feature flag.
maria.design: thanks all — I'll update the Figma and the spec doc with the path contract and rollout plan. pinging @nav-bot to create the ticket.
nav-bot: Created issue RED-3567: "Rail IA: regroup, redirects, breadcrumbs & deep-link contract" — assigned to oliver.frontend, kai.eng; due 2025-11-10. :white_check_mark:
